name: Charles E. "Chad" Baruch
tagline: Top rated Appellate attorney in Dallas, Texas
about: Few Texas lawyers can match Chad Baruch's broad experiences: college basketball coach, government professor, private investigator, high school administrator, constitutional scholar, and Board Certified attorney in Civil Appellate Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Chad is an award-winning speaker on appellate writing and advocacy, has served on the Board of Directors for both the State Bar of Texas and the State Bar College. In recognition of Chad's commitment to justice for all Texans, the Texas Access to Justice Commission named him a Pro Bono Champion in 2010. Committed to clients, respected by peers, devoted to justice, Chad is an appellate advocate whose approach and experience make a difference.
